name: editor
description: Integer, orthogonal, path-only SVG editing library for synoptic-view symbols.

scripts.build: npm run deps:audit && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.fix: cargo run --release -q -p format -- --write "*" .cargo .claude/agents .claude/hooks .claude/rules .claude/skills .claude/settings.json .github .husky .vscode docs eslint playground scripts src tests tools && eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ --fix "*.{ts,md}" .claude/agents .claude/hooks .claude/rules .claude/skills .github docs eslint playground scripts src tests
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:secrets && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run deps:audit && npm run deps:unused && npm run check:rust
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --quiet && npm run --silent rust:advisories && npm run --silent rust:coverage && cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked --quiet --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && npm run --silent rust:build
scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings=0 "*.{ts,md}" .claude/agents .claude/hooks .claude/rules .claude/skills .github docs eslint playground scripts src tests
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix "*.{ts,md}" .claude/agents .claude/hooks .claude/rules .claude/skills .github docs eslint playground scripts src tests
scripts.format: cargo run --release -q -p format -- --write "*" .cargo .claude/agents .claude/hooks .claude/rules .claude/skills .claude/settings.json .github .husky .vscode docs eslint playground scripts src tests tools
scripts.format:check: cargo run --release -q -p format -- --check "*" .cargo .claude/agents .claude/hooks .claude/rules .claude/skills .claude/settings.json .github .husky .vscode docs eslint playground scripts src tests tools
scripts.docs:api: cargo run --release -q -p api-pages -- src/index.ts docs/api /api/ editor
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:api && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- sh -c "npm run docs:api && vitepress build docs"
scripts.rust:coverage: cargo llvm-cov --version > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'cargo-llvm-cov is missing: rustup installs llvm-tools from rust-toolchain.toml, then run cargo install --locked cargo-llvm-cov@0.9.1 (docs/tooling/commands.md)' >&2; exit 1; }; cargo llvm-cov --workspace --locked --quiet --summary-only --fail-under-lines 93 --fail-under-functions 93 || { echo 'Rust tests failed, or their coverage fell under the floor of 93 % of lines and 93 % of functions (docs/tooling/commands.md)' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.rust:advisories: cargo deny --version > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'cargo-deny is missing: run cargo install --locked cargo-deny@0.20.2, then cargo deny fetch db (docs/tooling/commands.md)' >&2; exit 1; }; cargo deny --offline check advisories || { echo 'A Rust crate has a RustSec advisory, or the advisory database is missing: cargo deny fetch db fetches it (docs/tooling/commands.md)' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.mutate: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- cargo run --release -q -p mutate --
scripts.golden:check: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- vitest run tests/golden-results.test.ts --mode golden-check
scripts.backlog:index: cargo run --release -q -p backlog-index -- docs/backlog && cargo run --release -q -p format -- --write docs/backlog/stories/README.md
scripts.story:finish: cargo run --release -q -p heavy-lock -- --lock merge node scripts/story-finish.ts
